# Story Title: Sneaker Tap After Rain
This story is targeted at All Ages, in the Warm Slice-of-Life Micro Short Film genre.
## Story Outline/Summary
Set in a high school campus right after a summer shower, two deskmates who have avoided each other for three days after a fight over a broken handmade model run into each other by the corridor. No words are exchanged, they complete their reconciliation with one small familiar action, the final slow push lingers on their relaxed, soft expressions, wrapping the whole warm story in 17 seconds with zero dialogue or narration.
## Main Characters Introduction
Lin, 17, high school sophomore, wears a crumpled blue school uniform jacket, has a scuffed white sneaker, has been too stubborn to apologize after their argument. Xiao Yu, 17, Lin's deskmate, tucks a half-damp sketchbook under her arm, has been too shy to initiate a truce since their fight.
## Full Story Narrative
(All runtime 17 seconds, no dialogue, no narration, only soft ambient sound of dripping raindrops and distant cicada chirps)
### Scene One (0-5s)
The frame opens on a glistening wet campus path, magnolia leaves hanging over the edge of the teaching building corridor drip leftover raindrops onto a shallow puddle. Lin is lingering by the corridor, kicking a small pebble, the half-broken handmade aircraft model tucked behind his back. He freezes when he looks up and spots Xiao Yu walking towards him, both of them dart their eyes away awkwardly, bodies tensing up.
### Scene Two (5-10s)
They stand two meters apart, the puddle right between their feet ripples as a new raindrop falls. The edge of Xiao Yu's sketchbook flips open slightly, revealing a half-drawn draft of the same aircraft model. Lin hesitates for a split second, then lifts his foot, taps the tip of his scuffed white sneaker gently against the tip of Xiao Yu's clean white sneaker — the silly little secret signal they used to use to say "no hard feelings" before their fight.
### Scene Three (10-15s)
Xiao Yu's eyes widen a little, then the corners of her mouth lift into a small, relieved smile. She lifts her own foot, taps his sneaker back, light as a falling raindrop. All the awkward tension between them melts instantly, both of their hunched shoulders slump loose at the same time.
(15-17s, final slow push运镜)
The camera pushes in slowly at a steady soft speed, framing only the two pairs of lightly touching sneaker tips, and the faint, wobbly reflection of their grinning faces in the puddle right next to their feet, before the frame fades out.

**SCENE 1**
EXT. HIGH SCHOOL TEACHING BUILDING CORRIDOR - RIGHT AFTER SUMMER SHOWER (0-5s)
Soft ambient sound of dripping raindrops and distant cicada chirps runs through the whole sequence, no dialogue, no narration.
Glossy wet bluestone path glistens under overcast post-rain light. Magnolia leaves hanging over the corridor eave drip leftover raindrops that splash tiny ripples on a shallow puddle at the corridor edge.
Lin, in crumpled blue school uniform, lingers by the pillar, kicking a small smooth pebble back and forth with his scuffed white sneaker. The half-broken handmade aircraft model is tucked tight behind his back, hidden from view.
He freezes mid-kick when he looks up. Xiao Yu, with a half-damp sketchbook tucked under her arm, is walking straight towards him. Both of them dart their eyes away the second their gazes meet, their shoulders hunch up awkwardly, bodies tensed like stiffened strings.

**SCENE 2**
EXT. SAME CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS (5-10s)
The two stop two meters apart, the shallow puddle sitting exactly between their feet. A new falling raindrop hits the puddle surface, spreading a ring of clear ripples.
The edge of Xiao Yu's half-damp sketchbook flips open slightly by the breeze, revealing a half-finished draft of the exact same handmade aircraft model they fought over.
Lin blinks slowly, hesitates for a split second, then lifts his right foot, taps the tip of his scuffed white sneaker gently, lightly, against the tip of Xiao Yu's clean white sneaker. It is the old silly secret signal they used to use to say "no hard feelings" before their fight.

**SCENE 3**
EXT. SAME CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS (10-18s)
Xiao Yu's eyes widen a little in surprise, then the corners of her mouth curl up into a soft, relieved small smile. She lifts her own foot, taps his sneaker back, the movement light as a falling raindrop.
All the awkward stiff tension between them melts instantly. Both of their hunched shoulders slump loose at the exact same time, their faces softening.
The camera executes a steady, slow push-in shot as required: it frames only the two pairs of lightly touching sneaker tips first, then drifts down to catch the faint, wobbly reflection of their grinning faces in the puddle right next to their feet. The frame fades out slowly to the soft sound of dripping raindrops.
